section: Alabama corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Flat rate on Alabama taxable income; was 5% for tax years before 2001.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue FAQ: What is the corporate income tax rate?

section: Alabama corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Business privilege tax rate range
value: $0.25 to $1.75 per $1,000 of Alabama net worth
note: Annual tax on corporations and LLCs measured by net worth; the rate rises with federal taxable income apportioned to Alabama ($1.75 at $2.5M or more).
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Summary of Alabama Taxes and Tax Incentives (May 2025)

section: Alabama corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Business privilege tax maximum
note: Financial institutions, financial institution groups and insurance companies have a $3 million maximum; electing family LLEs are capped at $500.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Summary of Alabama Taxes and Tax Incentives (May 2025)

section: Alabama corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Business privilege tax small-taxpayer threshold
note: Entities whose privilege tax would be $100 or less do not have to file.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Summary of Alabama Taxes and Tax Incentives (May 2025)

label: Levied by
note: Counties and cities levy millage on top of the state's 6.5 mills; ADOR cites an average combined rate of about 43 mills.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Summary of Alabama Taxes and Tax Incentives (May 2025)

label: State oversight
value: Alabama Department of Revenue, Property Tax Division
note: Assessment is done by county assessing officials; the division advises county officials and boards of equalization.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Property Tax

label: State property tax rate (maximum)
note: State millage cap of 6.5 mills ($6.50 per $1,000 of assessed value) under Section 214 of the Alabama Constitution.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Summary of Alabama Taxes and Tax Incentives (May 2025)

label: State homestead exemption (under 65, not disabled)
note: Up to $4,000 of assessed value exempt from state tax ($2,000 for county tax); owners 65+, disabled or blind get larger exemptions.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Homestead Exemptions

label: Deed tax
value: $0.50 per $500 of value or fraction thereof
note: Recordation tax on deeds (and bills of sale) under Code of Alabama Sections 40-22-1 to 40-22-12; collected at recording.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Recordation Tax

label: Deed tax rate
note: $0.50 per $500 equals 0.1% of value, charged per $500 or part of $500.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Recordation Tax

label: Mortgage recording tax
value: $0.15 per $100 of indebtedness or fraction thereof
note: Also applies to deeds of trust and conditional sale contracts.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Recordation Tax

label: Revenue split
value: Two-thirds state General Fund, one-third county
note: Taxes on the transfer of real estate. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Alabama Department of Revenue: Recordation Tax
